authorized_scope: Locate, validate, and load available datasets, then begin bounded runs only if the data and resource gates pass.

searches.repository_and_local_exports: Searched PRO-BLADE repositories and indexed local files for parquet, CSV, price, return, panel, CRSP, market, and manifest candidates.
searches.google_drive: Read-only searches for CRSP, WRDS, Wharton market data, panel.parquet, point-in-time prices, CSV, Excel, parquet, and manifest files found no market-data export matching the FREM contract.

rejected_candidates.rows_and_scope: 8 surviving US equities, 1760 shared dates, 2018-01-02 through 2024-12-30
rejected_candidates.validator_result: FREM inspect-data rejected the unmapped source at the timestamp contract before any model execution.
reasons: date-only observations rather than verified exchange timestamps
retrospective Yahoo auto-adjusted close without separate action or point-in-time revision history
rectangular dropna intersection with acknowledged survivorship bias
no historical eligibility, delisting, availability, FX, or permanent-identifier evidence
source manifest explicitly says it is not a licensed institutional feed and requires independent review
monthly returns only, without executable prices
no separate corporate actions, availability timestamps, or historical eligibility
upstream provenance states Yahoo Finance through yfinance
already used for retained compatibility runs

execution_decision.reason: No candidate satisfies the canonical price, action, timestamp, availability, eligibility, delisting, currency, and license/provenance contract.
execution_decision.resource_gate: Free plus speculative memory remained below the 512 MiB project floor; the existing synthetic matrices were not redundantly rerun under pressure.

minimum_evidence: lawful provider/export identity and research-use rights
raw prices plus actions or a documented total-return methodology
historical eligibility/universe source and terminal outcomes
currency and timestamped FX where required
unmodified source hashes and retrieval/version metadata
